resources.string: Android 16+. Enable the system glucose notification and status chip. Uses MetricStyle automatically on Android 17+.
Android 17+. Display glucose using the system metric template.

Independent of the floating overlay. Live Update and automatic MetricStyle on Android 17+ share notification content and chip settings. If MetricStyle fails, standard Live Update uses the same settings. The system controls promotion; without fresh data the normal notification returns.
Current reading in the notification. Does not change the status chip.
Direction of glucose change. An unknown trend is not shown as a flat arrow.
Display mg/dL or mmol/L according to the selected glucose unit.
Time when the displayed reading was taken, not when the notification was refreshed.
Add a short description of the displayed reading.

These options affect this notification only. Main text is shown in the expanded notification; when it is empty, the caption is used as the body. Android controls final placement and may shorten text. App identity can remain visible.

Shared Live Update settings. On Android 17+, main content is the MetricStyle metric; in the standard fallback it is the expanded body. An empty MetricStyle metric or caption is represented by a dash because nonblank fields are required. Android controls font sizes and final placement.
